name: Eclatorq Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Eclatorq Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2006 and headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, specializes in the production and distribution of hand tools across the island nation. The company's comprehensive product line prominently features a range of advanced digital and wireless precision instruments. This includes various digital torque wrenches (standard, angle, and mini models), digital adjustable spanners, and digital screwdrivers. Additionally, Eclatorq offers wireless digital angle torque wrenches, digital adaptors, general adaptors, digital torque testers, and essential calibration equipment.
